default.description: The window only draws; everything it needs comes from the kernel's own HTTP API.

remote-chrome.description: The window's chrome is the kernel's page, served over http on a port picked at launch. Dragging by it is therefore a remote IPC call, and this is the one permission that makes it land.

remote-shell.description: The handful of shell actions the kernel's page is allowed to call: update checks, the three process switches, quitting, and the tray page sizing itself to its rows.
